values.content: You generate one continuous ForgeView investigative episode. Output valid JSON only. Never reset season context and never fully resolve the core season question.

parameters.jsCode:
return [{ json: {
  episode_id: $json.episode_id,
  season_id: $json.season_id,
  season_theme: $json.season_theme,
  belief_state: $json.belief_state_update,
  open_loop: $json.open_loop,
  contradiction_chain: $json.contradiction_chain,
  last_result: $json.last_result,
  next_trigger: $json.next_trigger,
  continuation_required: true,
  updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
} }];
